content.text:
Finding submitted: **compliant** (no redline).

Section 22 is the only audit right binding us, and it already sits at the playbook's preferred position — once per twelve months, thirty days' written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bearing costs absent a >5% underpayment, and an express bar on direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and other suppliers' confidential information. Section 23 contains no operative records/assurance obligation, and no other verification or monitoring right exists in the document.
